tools.name: validate_saft
tools.description: Check a Romanian SAF-T file (D406) before filing it with ANAF: runs ANAF's official validator (DUKIntegrator) for the reporting period and the consistency checks it does not do offline (balanced entries, GL totals, opening + movements = closing per account, trial balance, partner balances, invoice t

tools.name: validate_saft_free
tools.description: Same check as validate_saft, free: 1 file(s) per day per client IP, report limited to the first 10 findings (the total count is given).

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Use before uploading an e-Factura to ANAF SPV or sending a Peppol invoice. Validate a UBL 2.1 invoice: every rule violation with a plain-English fix, the UBL path of the field and, for amount errors, the correct value. Paid: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (network eip155:8453); without a payment it re

tools.name: fix_invoice
tools.description: Repair the invoice automatically and return the corrected XML: county/sector/country/currency/unit codes, date formats, VAT-id prefixes, decimals, totals and VAT recomputed from the lines. Lists every change (field, old, new) and re-validates the result. Paid: $0.05 USDC via x402, charged only if so

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Create a complete Romanian e-Factura (UBL 2.1 CIUS-RO XML) from simple data: invoice number, dates, seller and buyer CUI, lines (name, quantity, unit, price without VAT, VAT rate e.g. 21 or 11), optional IBAN. Company names, addresses, county codes, Bucharest sectors and VAT status are filled from A

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Romanian company data by CUI (fiscal code) from ANAF, already in e-Factura form: legal name, VAT id (RO… only for VAT payers), trade register number, address with county as ISO code (RO-CJ) and Bucharest city as SECTOR1..6, plus flags: inactive, VAT on collection, e-Factura registry. Free.

tools.name: validate_invoice_free
tools.description: Start here if you have no crypto wallet: same report as validate_invoice (Romanian e-Factura CIUS-RO, Peppol BIS 3.0, EN 16931), free, 3 calls per day per client IP, no account or key. When the quota is used up, switch to validate_invoice.

tools.name: fx_rate
tools.description: Official BNR (National Bank of Romania) exchange rate: RON per 1 unit of the currency, for a date (default today; weekends/holidays return the last publication). Omit currency for all rates. Free.

tools.name: ro_holidays
tools.description: Romanian public (legal) holidays for a year, incl. Orthodox Easter and Rusalii. Free.

tools.name: ro_business_day
tools.description: Is a date a Romanian working day, which is the next one, and (optionally) the date N working days later. Free.

tools.name: ro_tax_deadlines
tools.description: Romanian monthly filing deadlines (D112, D300, D100, D390, D394, D406) for a reporting month, moved to the next working day when they fall on a weekend or holiday. General rules; confirm special regimes with ANAF. Free.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Check an IBAN (length and check digits) and name the Romanian bank. Free.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Explain one business rule by its id (e.g. BR-CO-15, BR-RO-110, PEPPOL-EN16931-R001): official text, plain-English fix and where the field lives in UBL. Free.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
